members.note: 第 3、8、10 章（chpost1）與第 22、23 章（chpost2）都不呼叫 0x3a2e0，src 裡所有「唯一不呼叫」的說法已改成列出同類處理函式。
成長值相等時實際成長就是該值，unitstat.c 的「上限多一」已限定在兩值不同時。
九個 slot 是名冊前九人（含蓋亞、不含瑪麗安），教會認的是肖像編號 0–8（含瑪麗安、不含蓋亞），兩者不同，註解已改。
與 P70 同一批修正；另把 CH08_RANDIS_UNIT_INDEX、第 15 章的「every other handler」與 chend1.h 第 8 章的同類唯一性說法一併改掉。
MAP00.DAT 第 21 筆索爾確有死亡腳本 opcode 5、運算元 0x0f，第 1 章註解已改寫成兩道判定並存、毒死只靠行動後檢查。
巫湯婆婆（MAP21 #7）、死神（MAP22 #52）、三名魔戰將軍（MAP24 #0–2）都是陣營 0，三處「小兵死光就過關」的論證都已改正；第 23 章轉呼還會因單位 0 開場已退場而立刻敗北。
依 FRIAPRDA.DAT 與 RANKUP.DAT 的職業代碼，clazz < 9 放進蘭斯洛特與蘭迪斯、裘娜、亞克的轉職型態，蓋亞（19）與珊（0E）並不在內，註解已改。
實測 FRILEVUP.DAT：300 對中 151 對相等，有成長的 35 列 175 對中 26 對相等，隊員型態 155 對中 15 對（多為 DX），三處註解已改成實數。
unitstat.c 已加上兩值不同的限定；church.c 那句同時改正：資產頁印的是原始 byte，只有兩值不同時才比最大可擲成長多一。
與 X10、X35 同一筆修正：補上兩值相等時固定成長該值。
第 1 章註解改為第 2、5、6 章只靠死亡腳本（運算元 255）、第 4 章只靠行動後檢查；「唯一先說話」不成立（第 3 章勝利分支也是先畫字），改為與第 3 章相同。
MAP08.DAT 非 255 的死亡腳本只有兩筆 opcode 0（B6）與兩筆 opcode 1（3000、1000 金），註解已改。
FDETXT15.TXT 首個 offset 50，共 25 條（0x00–0x18）；src 註解改正，測試常數依規則不動，改註解說明它是合成筆數。
單位 0x1f 是 MAP22.DAT 第 21 筆（陣營 1、角色 0x24、行為 7、目的地 (24,3)、COD 起點 (24,24)），0x14 是尤利安與法蓮娜的喊聲，三處註解已改寫。
ICON00.DAT 在 0x051c 以 SWITCH_MAP 0 重建地圖 0，加入只需在過場之前，第 1 章註解已改。
費塔加由第 3 回合 fdps_chapter_08_event_for_turn 播放的 Icon7-1.dat 以 DEPLOY_WAVE 部署，0x37440 只改 AI；src 兩處與 Ghidra 0x3a710 plate 同類錯誤一併列出。
ICON08.DAT 偏移 0x1a5 的 SWITCH_MAP 8 重建地圖 8，約束是加入須在過場之前，第 9 章 init 註解已改。
與 X46、X182 同一筆修正。
與 X183 同一筆修正：巫湯婆婆是陣營 0，轉呼只在她被毒死時改變結果。
寫回對已退場的角色 0 整筆跳過，第 19、24 章結束處理註解已扣掉蘭迪斯。
與 P70 同一筆修正：0x3a8c0 註解改為本檔三支不呼叫共用判定之一。

   the first is the shared test's slot 0 and the second is this store.  Unlike

edits.new:
The chapter's two stated lose conditions are 蘭迪斯 dying and 索爾 dying:
   the first is the shared test's slot 0 and the second is this store.  索爾's
   deployment record in map00.dat (record 21) also carries a death script,
   opcode 5 with operand 0x0f, so a 索爾 struck down in combat has his line
   drawn twice: fdps_run_death_scripts draws entry 0x0f and records the
   defeat, and this handler, which looks only at his slot and never at the
   code, draws it again at the end of the same action.  A 索爾 killed by
   poison bypasses the death scripts -- fdps_battle_tick_status_effects
   settles the death and calls the post-action handler directly -- so this
   store alone ends that battle.  Chapters 2, 5 and 6 rely on the death script
   alone (opcode 5, operand 255, no text) and chapter 4 on its post-action test
   alone; reshaping this handler after chapter 2's and leaving the condition to
   the death script lets a poisoned 索爾 end nothing (rebuild_info/pitfalls.md).
   Like chapter 3's victory arm, this handler speaks before it records.
edits.why: C:X46, C:X182, V:rebuild_info__pitfalls__1#9 (chapter 1 death script and the dropped uniqueness of speaking first)

the obvious `clazz < 9` lets 蓋亞, 珊 and 蘭斯洛特 through, and every

   shuts out 法蓮娜, 費塔加, 瑪麗安, 尤利安, 琴琴 and 布蘭多 (initial classes

   records, out of bounds with 蘭斯洛特's character id 0x0b

   figures assets/characters.md prints, and, for a pair whose two bytes differ,

   whole.

CHAPTER 9 IS THE FIRST CHAPTER WHERE THE ADD-BEFORE-REBUILD ORDER IS
   OBSERVABLE.  MAP08.DAT declares EIGHT player slots -- byte +1 of the block
   (src/rsrc.c) -- and the party is six members strong when the chapter opens:
   chapters 1 to 4 add one each, chapters 5 and 6 add nobody, chapter 7 adds
   裘娜 and chapter 8 adds 費塔加.  The two adds here take it to eight, which
   is exactly what the map asks for.  fdps_build_map_unit_array fills player
   slot i from roster slot i only while i is below the roster count and zeroes
   the slot with UNIT_FLAG_RETIRED set otherwise (src/deploy.c), so a rebuild
   that ran before these two adds would leave slots 6 and 7 as retired blanks
   and neither 布蘭多 nor 蓋亞 would be on the map -- in a chapter whose losing
   condition is either of them dying.

   (src/rsrc.c) -- and the party is six members strong when the chapter opens:
   chapters 1 to 4 add one each, chapters 5 and 6 add nobody, chapter 7 adds
   裘娜 and chapter 8 adds 費塔加.  The two adds here take it to eight, which
   is exactly what the map asks for.  fdps_build_map_unit_array fills player
   slot i from roster slot i only while i is below the roster count and zeroes

   and 蓋亞; adds that ran after fdps_icon_script_run would leave slots 6 and 7
   as retired blanks and neither of them on the map -- in a chapter whose
   losing condition is either of them dying.

ghidra.detail:
Returns a pointer to one record of the class equipment table loaded from PROEQU.DAT: the item types the class is allowed to equip.

Algorithm:
Multiplies class_index by 6, the PROEQU.DAT record stride, adds the table base pointer held in the global at 0x00063fe4, spills the sum to a stack local and reloads it into EAX as the return value. fdps_load_data_tables@00018930 fills that global at startup by loading "ProEqu.dat" through fdps_vfs_load_file_or_exit, so the pointer is valid from startup until teardown. There is no null check on the base pointer and no bounds check on the index: the table holds 36 records, covering class codes 0x00..0x23, while class codes run to 0x27, so 0x24-0x27 address memory past its end. No unit that reaches the only caller carries such a class: every unit on the shop, village-equip and player-phase paths has a class from FRIAPRDA.DAT or RANKUP.DAT, at most 0x19.

The record is six bytes from the same value space as byte +0 of an ITEM.DAT record, the item type. They are a variable-length set, stored in ascending order and right-padded with 0xff -- not six fixed slots: in the shipped table a given type sits at whichever position the sorting puts it in, and records run from one type used (class 0x1a, 0e ff ff ff ff ff) to all six (classes 0x0b, 0x0c, 0x0f..0x12 and 0x20). The only caller, fdps_unit_can_equip_item, scans all six positions identically and returns 1 when one of them equals the type of the item it was asked about, which makes this table the "which item types may this class equip" list. The 0xff padding never matches because no ITEM.DAT record carries type 0xff; one code that does appear in the table, 0x2d in the records for classes 0x20 and 0x21, is carried by no item either.

Parameters:
  class_index -- the unit's class code, taken straight from byte +0x20 of its 0x50-byte unit record. Passed raw, not incremented: the PROMAP.DAT accessor fdps_get_class_record is fed class code + 1, this one is not.

Returns:
  Pointer to the class's 6-byte record, i.e. base + class_index * 6. It is address arithmetic only and is never NULL while the table is loaded, whether or not the index is in range.

Pool: fdps  [no Function ID hit in either library set; its only data reference is the game global at 0x00063fe4, written by the game's own table loader, and its only reference is a static call from game logic]

Rebuild note:
Two ways the obvious rewrite diverges. (1) PROEQU.DAT is indexed by the raw class code, while its neighbour PROMAP.DAT is indexed by class code + 1 -- the callers of fdps_get_class_record that look up a particular unit INC its byte +0x20 before calling (all but fdps_map_actor_move_toward_nearest_reachable_opponent, which omits it, an original defect), the caller of this one does not. Writing the equipment lookup by analogy with the class lookup and adding 1 shifts every class's permitted-equipment list by one record. The table is also 36 records against 40 class codes, so classes 0x24-0x27 read past its end and this accessor does not check. (2) The unused positions of a record hold 0xff, not 0, and the scan in fdps_unit_can_equip_item has no sentinel test at all -- it compares all six. Treating 0 as the empty marker is the intuitive reading and it is wrong: 0x00 is the type byte of the 25 all-zero ITEM.DAT records 0xE2-0xFA and of no item with content, so a table or a comparison written that way would let every class with an unused position -- all but 0x0b, 0x0c, 0x0f..0x12 and 0x20 -- equip all of them.

conclusion: 人物初始法術的四筆攻略站歧異（蘭迪斯、費塔加、珊、蘭斯洛特）不是攻略站寫錯：資料檔是入隊時的 FRIAPRDA.DAT 遮罩，攻略站列的是玩家實際拿到的法術（第 1 章勝利授予的業火，或戰鬥結束寫回時整筆蓋過名冊記錄的部署記錄遮罩），crosscheck.py、fdps-data 資料集與 SKILL.md 的「以資料檔為準」都加上這個例外；物品與法術的距離欄位以大小比較解讀（0x10 以上為直線、長度為值減 0x10），不是位元加低 4 位；fdps_get_class_record 的 11 個呼叫點是 7 個加 1、3 個傳 0（0x11e90、0x13056、0x13436）、1 個漏 INC（0x126f6），src 註解與 known_bugs.md 不再說「每個呼叫端」；PROEQU.DAT 空位填 0xFF 而非 0x00 的理由是 0x00 只屬於全零的 25 筆 ITEM.DAT record 0xE2–0xFA。

[V:assets__tables__classes#2] (found while verifying assets/tables/classes.md)
  the problem: `ITEM.DAT` 251 筆裡類型 `0x00` 只出現在 `0xE2`–`0xFA` 這 25 筆整筆為零、沒有內容的 record；226 個有內容的物品類型都在 `0x01`–`0x2C`（assets/tables/items.md 亦如此寫）。所以 `0x00` 不是活的物品類型。能說的事實是：`0xFF` 不是任何物品 record 的類型值，而以 `0x00` 填空位會讓每個職業都准許那 25 筆全零 record。
  the fix asked for: rebuild_info/pitfalls.md 第 79 行（PROEQU.DAT 變長集合那一列）的「用 `0x00` 當終止值會提早收手——`0x00` 本身就是一個活的物品類型碼」與資料不符：ITEM.DAT 的類型 0x00 只出現在 0xE2–0xFA 25 筆全零 record，PROEQU.DAT 36 筆也沒有任何一格是 0x00，以 0x00 終止對這 36 筆不會提早收手。應刪去這個理由，改寫為真正的偏差：因為空位全在尾端、且沒有物品類型是 0xFF 或出現在空位之後，任何終止判斷（0x00 或 0xFF）對職業 0x00–0x23 的 36 筆與全掃結果相同；只有越界的職業碼 0x24–0x27 讀到檔案後面的 byte 時，終止判斷才會與原版的六格全掃結果不同。

[V:program_info__cd_audio#1] (found while verifying program_info/cd_audio.md)
  the problem: 執行檔內其實有 `INT 2Fh` 指令：Watcom CRT 的 `int386x` 以 `0x4e326 + n*3` 跳進一張 256 筆「`INT n`; `RET`」的 stub 表，`0x4e3b3` 就是 `CD 2F C3`。MSCDEX 安裝檢查（AX=1500h）由 `fdps_cdrom_detect`（`0x3c636`）以 `int386(0x2f, ...)` 在保護模式直接發出，走的就是這個 stub；只有 device request（AX=1510h，需要 ES:BX 指向真實模式記憶體）才由 `0x3bb7d` 經 DPMI 0300h、以 BL=2Fh 模擬。兩條路徑的中斷編號都是執行期資料，所以用指令特徵搜不到呼叫點。
  the fix asked for: rebuild_info/pitfalls.md 第 99 行「CD 命令的 INT 2Fh 不是指令」要同步改：安裝檢查走 int386(0x2f)（CRT stub 表裡的真 INT 2Fh），只有 AX=1510h 走 DPMI 0300h。

  the problem: 這段把只屬於 RLE kernel 的特徵套到全部 24 支。分派者 `fdps_blit_dispatch` 與存檔兩支都有 `PUSH EBP`／`MOV EBP,ESP` prologue、以堆疊收參數；鍵盤 7 支沒有參數也不碰呼叫端的 frame；蓋掉參數槽的只有四支 kernel。鍵盤與存檔 9 支的前向短跳後面沒有 NOP（例：`000567cd` 的 `JZ` 緊接下一道指令），build_flags.md 的 NOP 指紋也只在 RLE 15 支上量過。Ghidra 的簽章也已不是 `__watcall` 自動分析：24 支全是 USER_DEFINED，22 支 `__cdecl`（kernel 是名義上的 `void __cdecl (void)`），`__watcall` 只剩兩支 ISR 相關；分派者與存檔兩支的 `__cdecl` 正是真的慣例。鍵盤與存檔 9 支被認出是組語，靠的是 wcc386 不會產生的形狀：checksum 以 EBX 當累加器卻不保存、ISR 以寫死的 selector `2` 載入 DS 並以 `IRETD` 返回、安裝常式 `PUSH CS`／`POP DS` 後把 DS:EDX 交給 DOS。
  the fix asked for: rebuild_info/pitfalls.md「原版手寫組語每個前向短跳後面都有 `NOP` 填充」那一列應限定為 RLE 繪製的 15 支；同一 object 尾段的鍵盤與存檔組語（`00056799`–`000568da`）前向短跳後沒有 NOP（例 `000567cd`、`0005685d`）。同檔「RLE 繪製的 15 支…重建保留原版組語」那一列的「kernel … 透過分派者的 EBP frame 讀第六個參數」應改為 10 支 kernel 這樣做，`fdps_rle_blit_passthrough`、`fdps_rle_skip_row`、`fdps_rle_blit_mirrored_horizontal`、`fdps_rle_blit_mirrored_vertical` 不讀寫分派者的 frame。

Nothing bounds the five indices and nothing reads data_fdps_map_unit_count;
   they are literals in the instruction stream and they are runtime unit
   indices, not deployment record numbers.  The unit array only grows and a
   retired unit keeps its index, so slots 0..2, the guest hero at 3, the
   heroine ICON03.DAT deploys at 4, the five cliff-top pursuers at 5..9 and the
   stand-in at 10 all hold their places even though the cutscene retires the
   pursuers and the stand-in, and wave 1 lands at 11..0x19 in record order.
   That puts 0x0d on record 3 (the ice mage) and 0x0f..0x12 on records 6..9,
   the eastern group map03.dat authors at behaviour code 2 (deployment record
   byte 0x11, copied into record byte 0x34 at 0002379d).  The merges therefore
   really take that group off holding position; they are not a no-op, and
   recomputing the constants from wave 1's record order alone would land them
   on other units.

ghidra.detail:
Moves a unit toward a requested destination tile: traces a path, retargets to the furthest walkable tile when the direct route is blocked, then picks the reachable tile nearest the target and animates the move.
Pool: fdps  [no Function ID hit in either library set; body is entirely game-domain]
Evidence: Calls only game routines - fdps_get_unit_record, fdps_get_class_record, fdps_move_path_trace, fdps_map_load_tile_info, fdps_animate_move_path - and reads the map probe result at DAT_00069d0c. malloc/free/abs are consumed, not joined. All callers are battle and map code. Not crt or ail (no library byte match, no vendor state area), not binary_artifact (945-byte body with a real frame).
Name: fdps_ + snake_case for game code; no library symbol identified, and none exists to identify.
Boundary: 000119e0-00011d90, Watcom prologue 53 56 57 55 89 e5 to matching epilogue 89 ec 5d 5f 5e 5b c3; the 15 bytes after are lea-form alignment padding before fdps_map_grid_collect_marked_tiles.
Signature: __cdecl, int (int dest_x, int dest_y, int unit_index, int side_select) at [ebp+0x14/0x18/0x1c/0x20], caller-cleaned (add esp,0x10 at every call site), result in EAX. The fourth argument is a side truth value, not a mode: it reaches only fdps_move_grid_mark_opposing_zones_of_control (00010be9..00010c07, marks the units whose side byte at +6 is non-zero when the argument is 0) and fdps_move_grid_block_occupied_tiles (0001197a..0001199d, which reads it with the opposite polarity).

Algorithm:
1. fdps_get_unit_record(unit_index) supplies tile x at +0x00, tile y at +0x01, a class index at +0x20 and a movement/terrain cost selector at +0x3b.
2. fdps_get_class_record(class_index + 1) yields the movement context; malloc(100) is the step buffer (one direction code per step) and malloc(0x800) is the reachable-tile list (x,y byte pairs).
3. Mark the opposing units' zones of control with fdps_move_grid_mark_opposing_zones_of_control(side_select), then build the movement cost map with fdps_move_grid_flood_fill_range(ctx, x, y, cost_selector) - only the flood builds the cost map, the mark does not - and path from the unit to (dest_x, dest_y) with fdps_move_path_trace(x, y, step_buf, dest_x, dest_y, 0), which returns the step count or -1 for no path.
4. On failure, reset, flood with NO mark and an allowance of 100, and retry with the relaxed flag 1. If a relaxed path exists, reset, mark and flood again with the unit's real allowance (00011af4), then replay the relaxed path step by step (direction 0 = y+1, 1 = x-1, 2 = y-1, else x+1), probing each tile with fdps_map_load_tile_info(x, y) and reading DAT_00069d0c. The last tile whose probe is not 0xff becomes the new destination - the request is retargeted to the furthest usable tile along the blocked route.
5. Rebuild the movement map, then narrow it with fdps_move_grid_block_occupied_tiles(unit_index, side_select), which does the OPPOSITE of flooding the unit's reach: it stores the 0xff unreachable sentinel into the occupied units' cells, so the mover may cross them but may not stop on them. Collect the tiles that survive with fdps_map_grid_collect_marked_tiles(tile_buf), which returns their count.
6. Scan those tiles and keep the one minimising |tx - dest_x| + |ty - dest_y|, breaking ties on the smaller ||dx| - |dy||.
7. Path to the chosen tile with the strict flag 0. If the step count is non-zero, fdps_animate_move_path(unit_index, step_buf, step_count) performs the move and the result is 1; otherwise 0.
8. Free both buffers and return.

Grid setup rounds: the grid is set up up to five times. Round 1 at 00011a5a does not reset first, so it inherits whatever the caller staged. Round 2 at 00011aaa resets and floods with NO mark and a literal allowance of 100. When round 2 finds a route, the retarget rebuild at 00011af4 resets + marks + floods with the unit's real allowance before the probe loop, the same setup as round 4. Rounds 3 (00011bc6) and 4 (00011cef) reset + mark + flood, and only round 3 calls fdps_move_grid_block_occupied_tiles. The retarget rebuild and round 4 aside, the rounds are NOT interchangeable: collapsing them into one shared setup would change which tiles the walk may cross and which it may finish on.

conclusion: fdps_battle_move_unit_toward（000119e0）最多重建移動網格五次：第 1 輪（不 reset）、放寬重試（不標控制區、移動力 100）、放寬重試有路時改目的地前的重建（00011af4，reset＋標控制區＋真實移動力）、列出能停的格（另挖掉有人站的格）、最後算路徑；只有改目的地前那次與最後算路徑那次設定相同，其餘不可合併。src 註解與 Ghidra plate 依此改正，探測讀到的是改目的地前那次重建的網格而非第 1 輪；知識庫兩頁先前已改好。

[C:X136]
  the fix asked for: src/aitarget.c 在 fdps_collect_targets_in_range 前的註解（"an impassable cell (flag bit 0x40) cuts it short"）把 0x40 稱為 impassable cell；0x40 其實是 fdps_move_grid_mark_zone_of_control 標在對立單位所站格的佔格旗標，而且每個呼叫點之前網格都已 reset，實際上不會出現。建議改成說明 0x40 是單位佔格旗標、所有呼叫點都在剛 reset 的網格上呼叫，所以射程實際上是地圖內的曼哈頓菱形。

[V:program_info__movement#5] (found while verifying program_info/movement.md)
  the problem: 目標範圍擴散時網格上從來沒有 `0x40`：`fdps_collect_targets_in_range` 自己不標控制區，所有 15 個呼叫點之前網格都已 reset（`flags &= 0x3f` 清掉 `0x40`／`0x80`），呼叫端也不標控制區。會標控制區的只有玩家移動、朝目標移動、AI 攻擊評分與部署找空格，它們結束前都會 reset。再加上第 0 列八個地形都是 1，所以擴散形射程（`range_code < 0x10`）就是地圖邊界內的曼哈頓菱形，不會被單位或地形擋住。另外 AI 法術評分 `fdps_map_actor_score_best_spell`（`0x13420`）也用第 0 列直接呼叫擴散，傳進去的是法術射程 byte 原值。
  the fix asked for: src/aitarget.c 的 fdps_collect_targets_in_range 註解「an impassable cell (flag bit 0x40) cuts it short」要改為：呼叫時網格已 reset、不帶 0x40，第 0 列也沒有 FF 地形，擴散形射程實際是地圖內的曼哈頓菱形。program_info/spell.md 法術流程第 1 步的「帶不可通行旗標的格會擋住擴散」與第 3 步的「這次同樣是洪水填充，所以半徑內隔著不可通行地形的單位不會被打到，即使確認時的菱形把它算進去」都要改為：範圍就是地圖內 |Δx|+|Δy| <= 值的菱形，不會被地形或單位擋住。

THE CUT-SCENE REBUILDS THE BOARD TWICE MORE BEHIND THIS HANDLER'S OWN
   REBUILD, which is what makes this member unlike its neighbours'.  Walked
   with the opcode ladder in src/icon.c, ICON24.DAT's 507 bytes hold
   eighty-eight opcodes and two of them are SWITCH_MAP: the third opcode, at
   script offset 4, sets the chapter id to 56 and resets the state onto that
   map, and the one at offset 183 sets it back to 24 and resets again.  Map 56

   returns the chapter id reads 24 again, put back by the script rather than
   left untouched.  The handler neither reads nor writes that global itself;
   the dispatcher that reached this slot is what put 24 there.

fdps_vfs_find_entry 以 *(unsigned char *)handle 取筆數，handle 路徑只看低 byte，與頁面敘述一致。
註解說明 00039d41／00039d53 的讀取只由 fdps_vfs_image_get_entry 使用，影像路徑獨立於 handle 路徑。

[V:rebuild_info__pitfalls__3#3] (found while verifying rebuild_info/pitfalls.md)
  the problem: 只對以 handle 開啟與查找的路徑成立（`fdps_vfs_open` 以 `MOVSX` seek、`fdps_vfs_find_entry`／`fdps_vfs_find_entry_size` 以 byte 讀筆數）。整個容器讀進記憶體後查找的 `fdps_vfs_image_get_entry`（`0x39cf0`，`anim.c`、`audio.c`、`death.c` 都用它查 `BaseAni.vfs`／`BaseWav.vfs`）把筆數當 32-bit 無號比較（`JC` at `0x39d1f`）、偏移以 16-bit 零延伸讀入（`0x39d34`），兩個上限都不存在。寫成一律 8-bit／帶號，那條路徑就與原版不同；反過來統一成那條路徑的寬度，handle 路徑又不同。
  the fix asked for: resource_info/vfs.md 的「成員數上限 255」「entry table 偏移上限 0x7FFF」兩條同樣只寫了 handle 路徑（見 cross_doc），由該頁的驗證者處理。
